tango.name: Tango
tango.desc: Consumes a tree or ward to gradually restore health over 16 seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal amount.

faerie_fire.name: Faerie Fire
faerie_fire.desc: Use: Consume the Faerie Fire to instantly restore 85 Health.

branches.name: Iron Branch
branches.desc: Use: Plant Tree — Targets the ground to plant a happy little tree that lasts 20 seconds.

null_talisman.name: Null Talisman
null_talisman.desc: After 25 minutes, Null Talisman gains +1.5 Mana Regeneration.

power_treads.name: Power Treads
power_treads.stats:
+50 Movement Speed
+25 Attack Speed
+7 Selected Attribute
power_treads.desc: Active: Switch Attribute — Toggles between Strength, Agility, and Intelligence.

mjollnir.name: Mjollnir
mjollnir.desc:
Passive: Chain Lightning — 30% chance on attack to release a bolt of lightning that bounces between 12 targets within 650 range, dealing 180 magical damage each.

Active: Static Charge — Places a charged shield on a target ally for 15 seconds. When attacked, 20% chance to release a bolt of lightning at the attacker dealing 225 magical damage.

silver_edge.name: Silver Edge
silver_edge.desc: Active: Shadow Walk — Makes you invisible for 14 seconds. Attacking to break the invisibility deals 175 bonus physical damage and Breaks the target for 4 seconds, disabling their passive abilities. Cooldown: 20s.

black_king_bar.name: Black King Bar
black_king_bar.desc: Active: Avatar — Grants Debuff Immunity and 100% Magic Damage Resistance. Duration: 9/8/7/6s. Cooldown: 65s.

aghanims_shard.name: Aghanim's Shard
aghanims_shard.desc: Upgrades an ability, or grants a new ability.

muerta.desc: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing 225 damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for 3s — rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed by 30% and takes 20% more magic damage.

ultimate_scepter.name: Aghanim's Scepter
ultimate_scepter.desc: Upgrades an ability, or grants a new ability.

muerta.desc:
Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.

Damage: 225/300/375/450

ultimate_scepter_2.name: Aghanim's Blessing
ultimate_scepter_2.desc: Permanently grants the Aghanim's Scepter upgrade to your hero. Does not grant stat bonuses. Does not use an item slot.

muerta.desc:
Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.

Damage: 225/300/375/450

bloodthorn.name: Bloodthorn
bloodthorn.desc: Active: Soul Rend — Silences a target for 5 seconds. At the end of the silence, an additional 50% of all damage dealt during the silence is dealt to the target. All attacks on the silenced target have True Strike and 100% Critical Damage. Cooldown: 15s.

devastator.name: Parasma
devastator.desc:
Passive: Magical Corruption — Attacks reduce enemy Magic Resistance by 3% per hit. Stacks up to 7 times.

Active: Crackle — Releases an energy bolt to the target that bounces between nearby enemies dealing magical damage based on stacks.

swift_blink.name: Swift Blink
swift_blink.desc: Active: Blink — Teleport to a target point up to 1200 range away. After blinking, gain 40% movement speed and +40 Attack Speed for 6 seconds. Cooldown: 15s.

moon_shard.name: Moon Shard
moon_shard.desc: Can be consumed to permanently gain 60 Attack Speed. Does not stack.

travel_boots_2.name: Boots of Travel 2
travel_boots_2.desc: Active: Teleport — Teleport to an allied unit or hero. Cooldown: 40s.

magic_stick.name: Magic Stick
magic_stick.desc: Active: Energy Charge — Instantly restores 15 Health and Mana per charge stored. Max 10 charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy hero within 1200 range uses an ability.

magic_wand.name: Magic Wand
magic_wand.desc: Active: Energy Charge — Instantly restores 15 Health and Mana per charge stored. Max 20 charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy hero within 1200 range uses an ability.

orchid.name: Orchid Malevolence
orchid.desc: Active: Soul Burn — Silences a target for 5 seconds. At the end of the silence, an additional 30% of all damage dealt during the silence is dealt to the target. Cooldown: 18s.

blink.name: Blink Dagger
blink.desc: Active: Blink — Teleport to a target point up to 1200 range away. Blink Dagger cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan. Cooldown: 15s.

monkey_king_bar.name: Monkey King Bar
monkey_king_bar.desc: Passive: Pierce — Grants 80% chance to pierce through evasion on attacks. Proc deals 70 bonus magical damage.

skadi.name: Eye of Skadi
skadi.desc: Passive: Cold Attack — Attacks reduce enemy movement speed by 30% and attack speed by 45 for 3 seconds. Reduces health regen and lifesteal by 40%. Ranged: 20% slow, 35 attack speed slow.

refresher.name: Refresher Orb
refresher.desc: Active: Reset Cooldowns — Resets the cooldowns of all your abilities and items. Cooldown: 160s.

satanic.name: Satanic
satanic.desc:
Passive: Lifesteal — 30% Lifesteal.

Active: Unholy Rage — Increases Lifesteal to 175% for 6 seconds. Cooldown: 30s.

revenants_brooch.name: Revenant's Brooch
revenants_brooch.desc:
Passive: Spell Lifesteal — 8% Spell Lifesteal.

Active: Phantom Province — Your attacks deal magical damage and can hit ethereal units for 6 seconds. 50% chance for critical hit dealing 130% damage. Cooldown: 45s.

bloodstone.name: Bloodstone
bloodstone.desc:
Passive: Bloodpact — 8% Spell Lifesteal. Spell Weakness Aura — Enemies in 1200 range take 12% increased spell damage.

Active: Bloodpact — Expend 40% of your current mana and recover that amount as health over 2 seconds. Cooldown: 85s.

sphere.name: Linken's Sphere
sphere.stats:
+16 All Attributes
+7 Health Regen
+5 Mana Regen
sphere.desc:
Passive: Spellblock — Blocks most targeted spells once every 12 seconds.

Active: Transfer Spellblock — Temporarily transfers Spellblock to an allied hero for 12 seconds.

sheepstick.name: Scythe of Vyse
sheepstick.desc: Active: Hex — Turns a target enemy into a harmless critter for 3.5 seconds. The target is silenced, muted, and slowed with a base movement speed of 140. Cooldown: 20s.
